Known ordinary-chi results then give the inverse degree and composite spectra, while direct-product identities give the iterate, order, and no-cross-block-diffusion claims. Exhaustive finite checks reproduce the conjugacies, inverse degrees, and differential uniformity in representative valid cases.

The closest prior source analyzes composite chi generally but predates this family. Targeted literature and current SCOPE searches found no equivalent identification. The claim is narrow and retains material folklore and near-simultaneous priority risk because the decomposition is short once noticed.
